connector.name: X402 Trust MCP
connector.registryDescription: Trust & reliability data for x402 endpoints before your agent pays them.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-trust-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jonasfuchss account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional Base wallet private key (with or without the 0x prefix). When set, the paid tools auto-pay over x402 up to X402_MAX_USD; otherwise they return a price quote. The free tools need no key.

env.name: X402_MAX_USD
env.description: Per-call auto-pay ceiling in USD. 0 disables auto-pay.

env.name: X402_MAX_TOTAL_USD
env.description: Cumulative auto-pay cap per process in USD. 0 = unlimited.

env.name: X402_MAX_CALLS
env.description: Max paid calls per process. 0 = unlimited.
